I could not verify this from first principles, so the answer rests on my recollection of the literature. I recall a result stating that $a(3,n)=6$ for all $n\ge 18$, which matches the value and threshold in Solution 3. Solutions 1 and 2 give 7 and 4, which do not match that recollection, and their justifications are sketchy: Solution 1 hand-waves its construction, and Solution 2 cites a "Walther graph on 18 vertices" with 4 longest paths, which I cannot confirm.

CHOICE: 3
